name: Morton Code Incremental Traversal
definition: An algorithm for iterating through a 3D voxel volume in Morton (Z-order) curve order using precomputed delta tables to update the linear index incrementally, avoiding expensive coordinate-to-index conversions except at chunk boundaries.
summary: Morton Code Incremental Traversal iterates through a 3D voxel volume in Z-order using precomputed deltas to update indices incrementally, avoiding expensive coordinate conversions except at chunk boundaries.
